title: Clove Legal, AZB & Partners, Stratage Law act on Adage Automation ₹230 crore fundraise
description: Adage Automation Private Limited has raised ₹230 crore from a fundraise led by InCred Alternative Investments, with participation from Global South Capital and Prachetas Capital.Clove Legal advised Adage Automation on this fundraise.The transaction was led by Dharmesh Kotadia (Founder and Senior Partner), with support from Nupur Rustagi (Partner) and Taniya Shah (Associate).Dharmesh Kotadia, Nupur RustagiAZB & Partners advised investor Global South Capital; and Stratage Law Partners advised
